title: Three implications for the investment committee

text: Three implications for the investment committee
Analyst judgment based on the inspected public evidence
IC discussion / Research cutoff 17 Oct 2026
1  Commercial evidence should drive underwriting
Request contracts, cash collections and retention. Separate recognized revenue from ARR, pilot activity, preorders and conditional order value.
2  Financing comparisons need a common basis
Keep historical priced rounds, proposed SPAC values and reported talks separate. Revisit Agility after the vote and any closing, without presuming either outcome.
3  Autonomy economics deserve a dedicated workstream
Measure interventions, productive utilization and service costs at customer sites. Capacity targets and model demonstrations cannot establish delivery economics.

Diligence implications. No recurring task is activated.
